title: Opening and Curran's first dance with Celestin's band
summary: Recording date, Curran's background as lifelong New Orleanian, and the first dance he attended around 1923 where Oscar Celestin's Dixieland band played.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: This interview was recorded on Tuesday night, 13th of May, 1958.

Can you give me a name please? My name is John G. Curran. Is it date of birth? November 27th, 1807. Place of birth? From the Rollins. Have you lived in New Orleans all your life? I have, with exception of four years when I went on my way to college. 1925, 1929. When did you first call work? There was a first thing in the old jazz. Well, so far back I can hardly remember. I can remember the first dance I went to, which was, well, it was about second year of high school. I went to a dance where Oscar Celestan, the Bigsland Band played the fantasy music. That was in the corner. That, when was that? That was about 1923. Oh, yeah.
